title: decision-guide heading says 'The Nine Questions' but there are now ten
reality: references/decision-guide.md line 14 reads '## The Nine Questions'. The section contains questions 1-9 PLUS the newly added 6b (UI functionality / Personal Extensions), for ten decision points. The count in the heading was not updated when 6b was inserted during the v2.4.0 sync.
fix: Either renumber 6b to 7 and shift the rest, or retitle the heading to 'The Decision Questions' / 'The Ten Questions'. Renumbering is cleaner long-term but touches cross-references; retitling is the safer minimal fix. Self-inflicted during this release's edits, so it should be corrected in the same cycle.

title: Persistent-state guidance contradicts variable macros — cross-lane confirmation
reality: SKILL.md decision-hierarchy item 8 states persistent structured state requires a 'Webhook tool + your own backend' because 'the engine's persistence is scoped to chats/characters/lorebooks'. The macro engine implements {{setvar::name::value}} / {{getvar::name}} / addvar / incvar / decvar (macro-engine.ts:1326-1336, docs/prompts/macros.md), which is in-engine state the guidance does not acknowledge. Independently found in the character-cards lane.
fix: Amend item 8 in SKILL.md and Q7 in references/decision-guide.md to check variable macros BEFORE recommending a backend: dynamic variables cover per-chat counters, flags, and small structured state; a webhook plus backend is for data that must outlive or span chats, or that is genuinely large or externally owned. Two independent lanes reached this — treat as confirmed.

title: SKILL.md hierarchy (8 items) and decision-guide (10 questions) no longer correspond
reality: SKILL.md's 'Decision hierarchy' has 8 numbered items; references/decision-guide.md has 1-9 plus 6b. The mapping diverged when the UI question was split into 6 (looks) and 6b (functionality) in decision-guide while SKILL.md folded both into a single three-tier item 7. SKILL.md says 'See references/decision-guide.md for the full version with examples', implying a correspondence that no longer holds item-for-item.
fix: Either align the numbering across both files, or change SKILL.md's pointer to state explicitly that decision-guide.md expands and re-splits these questions rather than mirroring them. Low severity but it undermines the navigational promise between the two files.

title: Ideation anti-patterns should reference activation keywords
reality: SKILL.md's anti-pattern "I'll build everything as custom agents" says agents fire every turn and cost tokens, and advises using them only for genuine per-turn automation. The engine provides Activation Keywords with a scan depth (default 5, max 200) that gate an agent to relevant scenes — the direct mitigation. Found independently in the agents lane.
fix: Amend the anti-pattern in SKILL.md to offer the middle path: keyword-gate the agent rather than dropping it. Currently the skill presents a binary (use the agent every turn, or don't use it) when a documented third option exists. Confirmed across two lanes.
